overview: Before you walked up to Holywell, the almanac already said no play. The afternoon line is struck. You did not write what the bill had been called. The forty leaves are beside the book, ready to go.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the two words and did not name the bill.

key_provisions.text: forty leaves unnamed on that line

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Wrote across the struck line and took the forty leaves

summary: Wrote across the struck line and took the forty leaves
